lesson.label: Classes
lesson.title: Every class detail in its place.
lesson.description: Subject, time, room, and teacher. Set shared subject details or make a change for a single class.

points.first: Use a schedule slot or set a custom class time
points.second: Class type, room, and teacher alongside the subject
points.third: Repeat every week or in selected cycle weeks

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.title: Recognize a subject at a glance.
appearance.description: A solid color or your own gradient, a familiar icon, and a distinctive card. Give each subject its own look in PlanIt.

points.second: Two-color gradients with an adjustable angle
points.third: Subject icons become a pattern on the card

appearance.hint: Pick a color or an icon to change the card.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.title: Homework stays with its class.
tasks.description: Write down what needs doing and link it to a class. The subject and time help you find the right task quickly.

points.third: Completed cards collapse to free up space

tasks.hint: Complete a task or add one of your own.

schedule.label: Settings
schedule.title: A schedule that follows your rhythm.
schedule.description: Set the start of your day, class duration, and breaks. Then choose the week cycle and reminder times for your schedule.

points.second: Multiple weeks in one schedule cycle

AppShowcase.title: Small things that save time between classes

ribbon.schedule: Build a schedule that works for you
ribbon.reminders: Get reminders at the right time

customization.title: A schedule you can read at a glance
customization.description: Give subjects their own colors, gradients, and icons, then add the lesson type, location, teachers, links, and an individual time when the day runs differently.

tasks.title: Homework stays with its lesson
tasks.description: Create a task from the class you are viewing or connect it later to a specific occurrence. The task keeps its subject, date, links, and attachments together.

reminders.title: Reminders that fit the subject
reminders.description: Use one lead time for most lessons and a different one for the subjects that need extra preparation.

materials.title: Photos, files, and links nearby
materials.description: After signing in, attach a board photo, handout, PDF, or study link to the lesson or task. Files you use again stay in a reusable library.

sync.title: Your changes are not silently overwritten
sync.description: If the same schedule changed on the device and in the cloud, PlanIt shows the conflict and lets you keep the local version, the cloud copy, or both.

sharing.title: Share only what is useful
sharing.description: Choose whether teachers, colors, links, lesson notes, and your name travel with the schedule. Codes can last 1, 3, 7, or 30 days.

widgets.title: Your next class without opening PlanIt
widgets.description: The home-screen widget shows lessons and breaks, highlights what is happening now, and moves to the previous or next day with a tap.

Platforms.title: A clear status for every version

ios.title: iOS
ios.description: The iPhone and iPad version is still in development. You can use PlanIt in your browser in the meantime.

android.title: Android
android.description: The main PlanIt app: start as a guest, synchronize after signing in, and keep the day's schedule on your home screen.

web.title: Web App
web.description: The current PlanIt web build runs in a browser and uses the same schedule and synchronization model.

CTA.title: Give your study week one clear place
CTA.description: Open PlanIt in the browser and start without an account. Add the schedule first; tasks, reminders, and materials can follow at your pace.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Content: In guest mode, PlanIt stores the schedule locally on the device. After sign-in, schedules synchronize with Firebase and also retain a local copy.
Privacy.section2Content: PlanIt supports email and password, Google Sign-In, and Apple Sign-In on compatible platforms. Authentication data is handled by Firebase Authentication.
Privacy.section3Content: Native builds include Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, and Google Mobile Ads. The full policy describes device data, advertising identifiers, third-party services, retention, and user rights.
Privacy.officialDocument: Open the application's full privacy policy

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Content: PlanIt is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. The service or individual features may be changed or discontinued.
Terms.section2Content: Users are responsible for the legality of information they add to schedules, including teacher contacts, links, and notes. Important data should also be backed up independently.
Terms.section3Content: PlanIt may be available through web and native platform distribution channels. Availability can vary by platform and region.
Terms.officialDocument: Open the application's full terms of service

CookieConsent.title: We value your privacy
CookieConsent.description: We use optional cookies and Firebase Analytics only to understand site traffic and improve PlanIt. Analytics stays off unless you accept.

errors.passwordMissingLowercase: Add at least one lowercase letter to the password.
errors.passwordMissingNumber: Add at least one number to the password.
errors.network: We couldn’t reach the PlanIt service. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: There have been too many attempts in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errors.operationNotAllowed: Password sign-in is disabled for this project. Contact PlanIt support.
